info.name: DAtuviSezaH
info.value: asya DAtoH rUpezu aco rahAByAM dve 8.4.46 iti vEkalpike dvitve kfte 'hUrCC' iti prApte tataH Kari ca 8.4.55 iti cartve 'hUrcC' iti cakArasahitaH CakAraH api Bavitum arhati .

info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to fall off, to move away, to retract

examples: 'tasmAdyo manuzyARAM medyatyaSuBe medyati vihUrcCati hi, na hyayanAya cana Bavati' (Sa0 brA0 2.4.2.6). vihUrcCati pAdAvasya vizamI Bavata ityAha.
